name: Qwen cutoff imitation and RL
selection: Use the final imitation checkpoint and its final RL continuation in every replicate. Freeze all training checkpoints before any test episode.
primary: Greedy strict shift success on identical paired cases. Estimate the mean RL-minus-imitation difference over three training replicates and 24 seed clusters; resample replicates and seed clusters with replacement, preserving all paired arms, families, and twins.
